page_title: VEN 3-2 UDI | Venezia v Udinese 30/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Davide Massa has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
90+5' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) is booked for saying more than Davide Massa was willing to tolerate.
90+5' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Davide Massa ignores the protests.
90+3' One of the players from Venezia times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' The linesman signals a throw-in for Udinese.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
86' 3 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Maduka Okoye no chance!
86' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Venezia!
84' There's a break in play and referee Davide Massa must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Venezia using VAR. This could be interesting!
83' Surely that's handball by one of the Udinese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
83' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
80' Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
80' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Marin Sverko (Venezia) replaces Giorgio Altare.
78' Lorenzo Lucca comes off the pitch to be replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
78' Substitution. Sandi Lovric will be replaced by Florian Thauvin (Udinese).
77' The current number of corner kicks is 2:6.
74' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Busio will be replaced by Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
73' That's the end of the game for Hans Nicolussi Caviglia, who is replaced by Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia).
72' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
70' The foul by Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Davide Massa.

68' A rebound falls to Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
67' The ball goes out for a corner. Venezia can continue in their attacking effort.
65' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
63' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Hassane Kamara is replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
63' Lautaro Giannetti goes off the pitch and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on.
63' Udinese force their opponents to concede a corner.
62' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Udinese.
60' Venezia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

60' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
58' The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
56' 2 - 2 Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) proves that he is an excellent free-kick taker after finding the back of the net with a clever shot that goes straight into the bottom right corner!
55' Substitution. Iker Bravo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Christian Kabasele (Udinese).
53' Isaak Toure (Udinese) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Davide Massa sends him off the pitch.
52' Corner kick. Udinese will have an opportunity.

50' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
48' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. John Yeboah comes off for Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
46' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Francesco Zampano (Venezia) comes on the pitch for Antonio Candela.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
41' 1 - 2 Goal! Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Maduka Okoye into the bottom left corner.
41' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) is going to take the penalty!
40' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) for a tough tackle.
40' A clumsy foul by Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) and Davide Massa blows his whistle. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Venezia.
38' The total number of attempts is 4:8.
36' The ball is behind the touchline and Udinese will take a throw-in.
33' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) is caught offside!
31' Filip Stankovic (Venezia) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
30' Udinese players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
28' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:3.
25' 0 - 2 Iker Bravo (Udinese) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
23' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) plays a through ball but overhits it.
19' 0 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
17' Martin Payero (Udinese) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Davide Massa's book.
16' Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
14' The ball has crossed the sideline. Venezia are taking a throw-in.
11' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) picks up a yellow card for a foul.

8' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Filip Stankovic anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' The ball is out of play. Udinese will take a throw-in.
3' Udinese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Venezia will kick the game off.
Davide Massa was nominated as the referee for this game.
